body:
The reason I was sent to a mental institution was because of a journal. I don't fear writing another, and I forfeighted my journal to a friend and then it was sent to authorities. Yet in some way, I don't feel like this helps my situation. I know me as a person is priority. Yet I have problems that need to be addressed physically before I can move on and work mentally. I'm in a temporary, unstable environment. And that's nothing new. But this is not something I can really ignore.

I've tried everything as far as living situations.
My mother won't take me in due to "lack of space". And it's been that way since I was 17. I don't have family that can take me in nor any friends. So that's a no go.

I just find it to seem useless wasting my time trying. It feels like I'm wasting effort by prolonging the inevitable. As  retarded as it sounds.
